title: Quick-Fix Irish Chicken Stew
description: A quick and easy, peppery stew originating from Ireland, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken stock, peppercorns, and parsley. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Add chicken thighs and cook for 10 minutes or until they're cooked through.
In a separate pan, heat oil over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together flour and a splash of cream. Stir into the pot with chicken stock and bring to a simmer.
Add cooked onion and garlic mixture to the pot with flour mixture. Stir in heavy cream and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Peel and chop potatoes. Add to the pot and cook for another 10-15 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
